report.summary: Test-infrastructure-only change: merges the worker, UI and component Vitest runs into one projects config, moves UI and component files to vmThreads, and makes workspace-events.test.ts run concurrently (describe.concurrent, maxConcurrency 4) with test-context expect. Each concurrent case gets its own user, project, Durable Object and FakeTempod. The only shared counter (seedCounter, used for the slug) is harmless because slug uniqueness is per project. I found no defect I can show. Blocked because node_modules is missing and the package download was denied, so I could not run typecheck or the tests, and could not confirm that @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers 0.23.0 supports concurrent cases with its per-test storage isolation, which docs/CI.md still says worker integration tests use.

findings.text: Concurrency in workerd is unverified against the real pool contract. Older @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers releases do not support concurrent tests while per-test isolated storage is on, and docs/CI.md line 45 still says worker integration tests run 'with storage isolation'. The pool's README or source isn't in the repo and the package isn't installed, so I could not confirm 0.23.0 allows this. To confirm: read the 0.23.0 docs, or run bun run test repeatedly on loaded CI runners.

evidence.why: This turns on 4 concurrent cases per file for the describe.concurrent groups in workspace-events.test.ts. If the pool still snapshots and restores storage per test, concurrent cases could see each other's storage pushed or popped and flake.

findings.text: Under concurrency, seedWorkspace reads the shared seedCounter after an await, so two concurrent cases can get the same slug. This is harmless: the unique indexes are per project (workspaces_active_slug ON workspaces(project_id, slug)) and every case seeds its own project.

evidence.why: This is a race on a shared module counter, but no constraint can fail because slugs are unique only within a project.

findings.text: Rule 6 requires changes to tests or CI to report stage timings. I cannot see the PR description, so I couldn't confirm the timing evidence for the merged single-invocation run and the 4-way concurrency.

checked.risk: Tests: shared state, globals and spies under concurrent cases; assertions that can pass without checking
Tests: artifact card assertions still check observable role, label, image src and click/Enter behavior
Idempotency/state across concurrent fixtures (D1 unique constraints, per-DO storage)
Real contracts: vitest-pool-workers concurrency and storage isolation, vitest projects, it.for and vmThreads (could not read the package sources; only the lockfile version)
Build and runtime environment: turbo cache inputs and typecheck coverage of the new config files
Spec and repository rules: CI budget and test rules documented in the same change
Failure paths and security: no product code changed; secrets only in existing test bindings
